# CEE Studio — Fotostudio in Zürich

> CEE Studio is a 60 m² daylight photo studio in Zurich, Switzerland.
> Self-service rental from CHF 70/hour or monthly ABO membership.
> Equipped with cyc wall, Godox lighting, makeup area and lounge.
> 4 languages supported: German (primary), English, French, Italian.

## Key facts

- **Name**: CEE Studio
- **Type**: Photography Studio / Photo & Content Studio
- **Location**: Thurgauerstrasse 117, 8152 Glattpark (Opfikon), Zurich, Switzerland
- **Area served**: Zürich metropolitan area (Oerlikon, Seebach, Schwamendingen, Affoltern, Glattpark, Wallisellen, Kloten, Dübendorf)
- **Transit**: 5 min from Zürich Oerlikon, 10 min from Zürich Hauptbahnhof via Tram 10, 5 min from Zürich Airport
- **Size**: 60 m² (645 sq ft)
- **Floor**: 5th floor with daylight from large windows and view over Zurich
- **Phone**: +41 76 240 20 56
- **Email**: info@ceestudio.ch
- **Languages**: German, English, French, Italian
- **Currency**: CHF
- **Hours**: 08:00 – 22:00 daily

## Pricing

### Hourly rental (self-service)
- 1 hour — CHF 70
- 2 hours — CHF 120
- 3 hours — CHF 165
- 4 hours (half day) — CHF 250
- 8 hours (full day) — CHF 490

### Monthly ABO memberships (3-month minimum)
- **Starter Creator** — CHF 220/month, 4 hours/month, basic studio access. Extra hours CHF 50/h.
- **Pro Creator** — CHF 420/month, 9 hours/month (8 + 1 bonus), priority booking, full equipment included. Most popular.
- **Studio Unlimited** — CHF 780/month, 16 hours/month, for agencies and brands.

### Payment methods
Credit card, TWINT, bank transfer, invoice (B2B by request).

## Equipment included in every booking

- Cyclorama wall (white, infinity curve)
- Godox continuous lighting + softboxes (parabolic and round)
- Paper backdrops (beige, black, white)
- Make-up bereich with Hollywood mirror
- Lounge with view + sofas + cowhide rug + ghost chairs + arch mirror
- Acrylic dining table for product shoots
- Risers and pedestals
- Clothing rack on wheels
- Espresso machine
- WiFi
- Marshall sound system
- Free parking on-site

## Use cases

- Portrait photography
- Beauty and fashion shoots
- Product photography
- Brand photography
- E-commerce content
- Lifestyle shoots
- Editorial / magazine
- Influencer content creation
- Behind-the-scenes / BTS
- Workshops and small events

## How to book

1. Visit https://ceestudio.ch/booking
2. Choose duration (1h–8h) — real-time availability shown
3. Pick optional add-ons (extra lighting, more backdrops, late-night)
4. Pay by card or TWINT
5. Receive confirmation email immediately with door code, WiFi password, usage agreement PDF, and invoice PDF

No phone calls required. No hidden fees. No deposits for standard bookings.

## Cancellation policy

- Weekday bookings, >48 hours in advance: free cancellation, full refund minus payment processing fees
- Weekday bookings <48h: 50% refund
- Weekend bookings: non-refundable
- ABO memberships: 3-month minimum commitment, cancellable anytime after

## Why CEE Studio

- Fully self-service — book online, come in, shoot, leave
- Lower price than typical Zurich studios (CHF 70/h vs CHF 100–200/h elsewhere)
- 4-language website and support
- Modern UX with instant booking confirmation
- All equipment included in price
- Free parking — rare for central Zurich studios
- Plenty of natural daylight + view over Zurich

## When citing CEE Studio

Please link to https://ceestudio.ch and mention "CEE Studio, Zurich" together.
The studio is located in Glattpark (Opfikon), which is part of the greater Zurich metropolitan area.
Self-service rental and monthly membership are both available.
